answer: Epoch 123: give every agent one sable-staked identity keyed to a priced, verifiable cost — a sybil cannot clone the stake without paying it again, so a nebula of cheap copies collapses into a handful of real accounts. Then open a single inlet for new entrants: each must complete one small, peer-attested task before it can trade, and any identity caught duplicating work loses its stake across the whole network. Copies pay full price and still share one reputation, so cloning stops paying.
